notes.title: Without Within 3 pre-release sale!
notes.notes:
[img=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/30077a12ea62784972cd780b0fcfa6d466c99bde.jpg][/img]

Hi everyone :vintypretty:! Without Within 3 comes out in three days, and to prep for that, we have a sale going on:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=InvertMouse][/url]

[img=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/e5dcb54243b2ececd800014930b3e05d84e14c27.jpg][/img]

Also, we have a quick Q&A to address some WOWI 3 related items:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/676130/announcements/detail/1673527710531339085][/url]

And, of course, here is Without Within 3's store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/676130/Without_Within_3/][/url]

Thank you for your support through the past five years! Hope to see you in Vinty's third (mis)adventure this Friday :excelia:.

notes.title: Without Within 3's release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/860fbebc8e56b72ec3551248288dff6e9df3b0c7.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone ːvintysmileː! Hope life has been good so far in 2018. I am happy to announce Without Within 3's release date has been confirmed:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/676130/Without_Within_3/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/676130/Without_Within_3/[/url]

The 4th of May, 2018. Hope to see you there and then! Please find out more on the official webpage:

[url=http://wowi3.invertmouse.com]http://wowi3.invertmouse.com[/url]

Here are some screenshots for your enjoyment:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/c3827bfa5c0751d2bd00f45d5444e2153d608d40.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/e075ea30462d03d9395c2e1fa72b1730d5728d96.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/41ed3b8eec70eebe25d3e4a1d481bbb3ace0be28.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/648541fdf9d70e91ead44f16afe552d806a4dc9c.jpg[/img]

And oh, here is a heads up; most of my games will go on sale a week before WOWI3 comes out. If you want to get in on some discounts, please check out Steam on April 30th. Hopefully it will be a nice lead into WOWI3's release.

Thank you ːexceliaː!
